## Description

This fan-made mod is created by re-processing existing game/video content using AI-based upscaling and enhancement techniques.

Videos are motion compansated from 25 FPS to 60 FPS using 3x upscaled AI images.

Just copy + paste and overwrite the content on your installation path:

```text
Robin Hood\Game\2047\data\Cinematics\
```

Works for all versions.

Enjoy!

Limafra
